question: How are the deity and the accompanying Śakti characterized in this form?
premises: The Śakti is described as dark-colored.
The deity is described as bearing the Śakti.
The deity is described as sky-clad.
inference: In this form, the sky-clad deity bears a dark-colored Śakti.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of dhārayantaṃ to śaktiṃ may allow more than one construal.
plain_english: He bears a dark-colored Śakti and is sky-clad.
